function: In-context MIMO equalization: tiny Transformer encoders at BSs compress quantized received signals; a GPT-2-style decoder at the CU estimates transmitted symbols from pilots, AoA and data (pp. 8-10)
system: Uplink FD-RAN: 4 BSs with 2 antennas each, 1-4 single-antenna UEs, 1 km square, fronthaul quantized to 4, 8 or 12 bits; band not stated (pp. 4, 11)
method: Supervised pretraining of joint Transformers (tiny encoders per BS plus GPT-2-style decoder-only decoder: 256-dim embedding, 8 heads, 4 layers) for in-context learning, trained on MSE loss (pp. 10-11)
data_channel: Custom simulator: correlated Rayleigh fading with path loss and shadowing; random user drops in a 1 km square; pilot length 8; mixed PSK/QAM (pp. 4, 11)
test_conditions: Pretrained on 2^13 tasks (user drops) with 2^10 realizations each, tested on 2^10 unseen tasks (new user drops), SNR sweep (pp. 11-12)
baselines: Non-learned: LMMSE without quantization and Bussgang-LMMSE (BLMMSE); learned: MAML meta-learning two-layer Transformer; GI_ICL without encoder is an ablation (pp. 11-12)
metrics: Equalization MSE (normalized) versus SNR, fronthaul capacity, pilot reuse factor, and number of pretraining tasks and realizations; relative MSE improvement over LMMSE (pp. 11-13)
complexity: none; only configuration (256-dim embedding, 8 heads, 4 layers) is given, and computational efficiency and inference latency are left to future work (pp. 11, 13)
q1_support: p. 4: "account a correlated Rayleigh fading channel, each channel" - custom simulator with random user drops in a 1 km area (p. 11); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 2: "training the model on existing user drops and testing it" on new user drops; p. 11: "unseen tasks. This ensures a rigorous assessment" - tasks are new user drops (new locations and spatial correlation) adapted from pilots, by ICL or MAML.
q3_support: p. 11: "performance of the ICL method gradually surpasses that of" MAML (learned meta-learning baseline, MSE in Table 2); p. 11: "achieves over a 29% improvement in MSE compared to" LMMSE (non-learned, Figs. 3-4).
q4_support: p. 13: "optimizing computational efficiency and reducing inference" is left as future work; p. 11 lists only the configuration, with no parameter count, FLOPs or runtime, and fronthaul bits are signaling only.
q5_support: p. 11: "We considered a 1-kilometer square simulation area, where" four access points - self-generated simulation data; no code or data link, no public dataset, and no availability statement appears in the paper.
notes: Included, area 1: MIMO equalization (symbol recovery) in a cell-free-like uplink with quantized fronthaul. Tables 1-2 and Figs. 3-6 were read from page images (pp. 5, 11-13). q2 is 1 because the test uses unseen user drops (new user locations and spatial correlation) adapted in context or by MAML from pilots, but they come from the same random generator, so the reviewer should confirm that this is not only a held-out split. The MAML comparison appears only in Table 2 (3-bit quantization). q4 is 0: no cost figure is reported.
